text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our way back from an excursion together, Yamanin Zephyr asks if we can stop by an organic shop on the way home.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Zephyr! What a coincidence! Here to do some shopping?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. I need some new face wash.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec, Bree-Z, is face wash the secret to your baby-soft skin?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bree-Z! Pretty plea-Z! Spill the tea on your skincare routine!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Apparently, Mejiro Palmer and Daitaku Helios have been having skin trouble as a result of staying up late…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Your skin's sooo pretty, Zephyr! It's, like, unrealistically smooth and glowing! I've actually been wondering what products you use!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I always use this particular face wash. It's an organic product made by the company my mom works for.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Organic! That's low-key so in right now! ☆

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'm no weather vane as far as trends go, though… I was simply raised alongside nature.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: My body was very frail when I was little, so I spent my days outside in the fresh air, surrounded by lush greenery.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I've enjoyed the blessings of nature throughout much of my life—I've eaten foods nurtured by bountiful winds, and frolicked among plants and animals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, I get it! So it's your lifelong organic diet that's made you so healthy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Organic stuff sounds god-tier! I feel like I have no choice but to pay my respects! By giving my skin a total glow-up!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: You're interested in trying some organic foods? Well, in that case…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr leads us all to the academy garden.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The vegetables here are grown without any chemicals, and every last one has been nurtured by a pleasant breeze.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: No cap?! I can't believe the answer to our skin issues was right under our noses the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The vegetables in that pile are too damaged to go to the cafeteria, but the school is happy to give them away to anyone who wants them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yay! I'd totally love some! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Okay, then… I'm going to go see how the dirt's doing for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Something tells me that's another beauty hack! Can we join you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Don't leave me out! I wanna see how you interact with nature. ♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Well… this is quite the atypical current. But you're welcome to come along.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Get outta here, weeds! …But whoa! Hahaha! ☆ Check out all these worms!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello, little Wiggler. You've grown so big. That just goes to show how good this soil is.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wowww. For real?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. Try sticking your hand into the soil. It's soft and warm. Those are the signs of good soil.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Okay, lemme try… Oooh! It's nice and toasty in there! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Grow big and strong, everyone! I've got high hopes for you guys!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh my, your voice resonates like a comforting breeze… I see you already knew the trick to raising delicious vegetables, Palmer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Yeah, the words just kinda came to me. It's like I can tell how eager to grow these little veggies are.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Go ahead and talk to them as much as you like. The more enveloping the radiant breeze, the more healthily they'll grow.
choice_data_list: Gotcha… Grow biiig and strong, you guys! And reeeal delicious!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I know it, the sun's gone down. It seems we all thoroughly enjoyed our time in the garden.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It looks as if the evening breeze will grow still soon. Let's start making our way back.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No… I was just wondering whether you had an interest in gardening perhaps. What made you decide to come along today?
choice_data_list: I wanted to learn more about you.
I wanted to learn more about you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No… I was just wondering whether you had an interest in gardening perhaps. What made you decide to come along today?
choice_data_list: I wanted to learn more about you.
I wanted to learn more about you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I see… So you found yourself becoming an affable flurry. Did you have fun?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec, I can't get this dirt outta my nails! It's like I got a mudicure! This is low-key hilarious. ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Another worm?! …Y'know, they're actually starting to look cute?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I see that everyone's feeling their own pleasant breeze. Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …So you wanted to find a new wind by interacting with nature.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! How do these two ever get their point across?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You got a tough journey ahead of you, Trainer, but I'm rooting for ya!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure whether Yamanin Zephyr and I are on exactly the same page, but I really do want to learn more about her.
